course.title: Polymer and Composite Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: You have created a composite system with a new kind of ballistic fiber. The fibers are continuous, aligned and brittle in nature, whereas the matrix is ductile. A load F is applied along the transverse direction. For the fiber volume of V, derive the expression of the modulus of elasticity for your composite system.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
